nodes.svg_description: Hand-drawn spiral notepad centered on canvas: irregular off-white sheet (#faf7f3) with rounded corners and an organic outline in warm olive-brown (#9b7a56). Across the top edge are evenly spaced rounded rectangular coil tabs (about 11), filled and stroked with the same olive-brown. The sheet has a slight wobble on the sides; the bottom shows stacked page edges with several short, curved horizontal accent lines and a small folded-corner-like flare at the lower-left, all in #9b7a56. No drop shadows; flat, vector look.
